hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/packages/mosaic" || exit 2; files="$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d HEAD -- ':(glob)src/**/*.ts' ':(glob)src/**/*.tsx' && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- ':(glob)src/**/*.ts' ':(glob)src/**/*.tsx')" || exit 2; if [ -n "$files" ]; then pnpm lint >&2 || exit 2; fi

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/packages/swingset" || exit 2; files="$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d HEAD -- ':(glob)src/**/*.ts' ':(glob)src/**/*.tsx' && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- ':(glob)src/**/*.ts' ':(glob)src/**/*.tsx')" || exit 2; if [ -n "$files" ]; then pnpm lint >&2 || exit 2; fi
